relics.name: Half-Open File
relics.desc: Your pieces, pawns and pawnlings in the bound lane move 12% faster; in the other two lanes 4% slower.
relics.counter: Position: Barricade stalls the faster wave. Fortress: Hold the File outlasts it.

relics.name: Closed Position
relics.desc: Rally. Your Bastions in the bound lane take 20% less damage and your pieces there gain 10% armor and resist; your pawnlings there deal 15% less. Off while you are not behind.
relics.rewards: Lock a lane you cannot win and win elsewhere.
relics.counter: Sacrifice: Pawn Sacrifice ignores the cap. Battering Ram strips armor.

relics.name: Crown Jewel
relics.desc: The bound piece deals 12% more damage and has 8% more health; your other four pieces deal 3% less.
relics.rewards: Pick one carry and build the team around it.
relics.counter: Initiative: Check and Fork on the obvious target.

relics.name: Development
relics.desc: The bound piece earns 20% more gold and reaches its Rank 4 and Rank 8 forks sooner; the enemy earns 50% more bounty for killing it.
relics.counter: Focus it: every kill pays the enemy more.

relics.name: Pawn Majority
relics.desc: Pawns cost 12 Tempo (from 15) and your pawn cap is 2 higher; your pawns have 10% less health.
relics.counter: Area damage clears them. Fortress soaks cheap pushes.

relics.name: Pawn Lever
relics.desc: Your pawns and pawnlings in the bound lane deal 20% more damage to Bastions and the Throne (still under the per-second cap).
relics.rewards: Pick the lane to crack; send pawns and the Ram.
relics.counter: Fortress: Hold the File and Closed Position. A Bastion Rook.

relics.name: Opening Theory
relics.desc: Cards from your Opening's two schools cost 5 Tempo less; other schools cost 5 more. Italian Game: every card costs 2 less.
relics.counter: The schools that counter your Opening's.

relics.name: Standing Order
relics.desc: Pick a lane card and a lane: it is always on there at half strength (Pawn Storm at one third). The card leaves your deck while it is bound.
relics.rewards: A lane doctrine with no live taps.
relics.counter: The card's own school counter: Fortress and Position against March cards.
